concern_summary: This concern encompasses the functionalities related to retrieving and displaying a user's profile details, including their display name, avatar, and various settings and options such as contact methods and status.
This concern focuses on managing the loading state of a user profile and managing the user's timezone settings, ensuring updates to the profile are handled appropriately.
Functionality that manages the active state of the back button, defining its behavior when temporarily inactive.
Functionalities related to triggering navigation back to the previous step or screen in the user interface.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to the management of the application operating in offline mode, affecting its network behavior.
This concern groups functionalities that manage the selection, updating, and display of different priority modes. It allows users to adjust settings based on priority interactions.
Functionality concerning the navigational buttons in a carousel, enabling back and forward movement through items.
This concern focuses on determining whether reports should be included based on the application's GSD Mode, prioritizing unread chats.
This concern focuses on the processing of web URLs, including the extraction of routes from provided URLs by handling various prefixes and local address formats.
